page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by the x86_64 architecture. The server features 104 dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY vCPUs operating at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core. This hardware configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options.

For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs positions this server as a dedicated compute node. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated Intel Xeon cores relative to memory makes it a viable option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk I/O.

Appropriate workloads for the ecs.c6.26xlarge include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, and large-scale web serving or application hosting where CPU performance is the primary bottleneck.
